summary: Iteration 11 re-test of the 11 iteration-10 bug fixes + full regression. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py (27 tests) and re-ran the whole suite — 155/155 pytest tests PASS (0 failures), including the 3 previously-failing bug guards in test_iteration10.py. Verified FIX#1 telemetry now aggregates per timestamp (S00001 hours=24 -> exactly 24 unique sorted rows, real solar diurnal curve 0 -> 1835.82 kW peak -> 0; hours=6 also aggregated; window slides at 6h, offsets differ across a 35s gap; S00378/379/380 now all return 24 rows), FIX#2 kpis?category=DoesNotExist returns every aggregate as 0 while Wind Farm still scopes to 30 sites and no-category returns 380/5473/800, FIX#3 all 4 severities accepted (Low/Medium/High/Critical, Critical total = 38, buckets sum to 800) and invalid/lowercase/empty severity -> 422, FIX#4 work-orders?status=Resolved status_breakdown = [Resolved] only with count == total, FIX#5 alarms?category=Wind Farm -> 232 alarms all on Wind Farm site_ids with root_causes summing to total, unknown category -> total 0, FIX#6 work-orders?category=Wind Farm -> 34 WOs all Wind Farm, unknown category -> 0. Auth regression: login/me OK, admin bcrypt hash starts with $2b$, all fleet endpoints 401 without Bearer, legacy /portfolios /alerts /snapshots /actions /team/users /reports/* /portfolio/metrics and the AI SSE stream still pass. Frontend (Playwright, admin creds): FIX#9 login copy = 'LIVE · MONITORING 380 SITES · 5,473 ASSETS'; FIX#8 tour step 1 anchors directly under [data-testid=kpi-capacity] (card y=531 vs target 393+121) and step 2 under [data-testid=category-switcher], tour-skip removes the backdrop; FIX#10 alarms-sev-Critical chip present, filters to '38 matching alarms', 15 CRITICAL badges rendered in red (color rgb(127,29,29) / bg rgb(254,202,202)) and SiteDetail S00220 Critical alarm uses the same red; FIX#7 clicking Wind Farm (category-5) re-scopes everything — KPI 5.26 MW/30 sites/251 assets, sites table 20 Wind rows, 'ALARM STREAM · Wind Farm / 232 matching alarms', 'WORK ORDERS · Wind Farm / 34 total work orders' with a Wind-only status breakdown, and switching back to All Fleet restores 800/141; FIX#11 dashboard @390px scrollWidth 390 == clientWidth 390 (no horizontal overflow); SiteDetail telemetry chart now draws a real curve (utility solar bell on S00001, wind profile on S00220); /alerts /reports /team still load; dark-mode toggle works; zero JS/page errors and zero error elements.

minor.issue: With hours=24 the offset is always 0 because a site has exactly 24 distinct timestamps (window == total, so `% max(1, total-window+1)` == %1). Two polls 35s apart returned identical rows/offset, so the SiteDetail chart labelled 'LAST 24H · LIVE' never actually moves at the default 24h window (sliding only observable for hours<24). Cosmetic/demo-only — data itself is correct.
Still loads all in-scope site_ids into memory (to_list(2000)) and passes a large $in for several sub-queries per request, polled every 5s. Pre-existing scalability note, not a regression.

ui_bugs.issue: Performance ratio still rendered unclamped — S00002 shows 101.0% (52.3 kW site). Pre-existing LOW from iteration 10, not part of this fix set.

issues: Alarm severity / asset-status badges still use hardcoded light pastel hex (#fecaca/#fee2e2/#fef3c7/#dff5e9) instead of theme tokens, so they stay pastel-on-dark in dark mode (pre-existing, not in this fix set)

action_items: Optional (LOW): make the telemetry sliding window meaningful at hours=24 — e.g. rotate the aggregated series (deque rotate by wall-clock) instead of slicing, so the default 24h 'LIVE' chart visibly advances.
Optional (LOW, carried over): clamp/annotate PR% > 100% in SitesTable/SiteDetail and move severity badge colors to theme tokens for dark mode.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/fleet.py telemetry: `offset = int(time.time()//30) % max(1, total - window + 1)` degenerates to 0 whenever window == total (the common hours=24 case); the endpoint still advertises live=True.

routers/fleet.py: the category->site_ids expansion is now duplicated in kpis, alarms and work-orders (3 copies of the same find+guard). Extract a `_site_ids_for_category(category)` helper returning None/[] to keep the empty-scope guard in one place.
routers/fleet.py is nearing the size/complexity where the alarms/work-orders/telemetry aggregations should move into a small service module, but it is still under the 700-line guideline.

rca_of_the_issue: No new defects. The only residual finding is that telemetry's sliding-window offset math collapses to 0 when the requested window equals the number of distinct timestamps for the site (24), so the default 24h dashboard/site chart is static despite live=True; the aggregation fix itself (group by timestamp, sum power) is correct and produces the expected diurnal curve.
